title: 分成一样多
subtitle: 分不完的时候怎么办
character: wearing a coral red t-shirt, navy shorts and white sneakers, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration in bright modelling clay style, rounded three-dimensional shapes with soft shadows, coral, sky blue and cream, playful and tactile

pages.zh:
桌上有六块饼干，
我们有三个人。
要怎么分
才公平呢？
pages.scene: The little boy stands alone at a low table, looking down at one plate of biscuits on the table, both hands at his sides, thinking. Only the boy and the table are in the picture.

pages.zh:
「平分」的意思是：
每个人拿到的
一样多，
一块不多，
一块不少。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: six circles on a cream background arranged in three groups of two, each group inside its own light box. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
可以一个一个发。
你一块，你一块，你一块，
再回头，
你一块，你一块，你一块。
发完刚好。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: three boxes in a row on a cream background, each holding two circles, with small numbers of arrows showing two rounds of dealing. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
六块分给三个人，
每人两块。
写下来就是
六除以三等于二。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: on a cream background: six circles on the left, then three boxes on the right each holding two circles. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
人多了，
每人分到的就少。
六块分给六个人，
每人只有一块。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: six boxes in a row on a cream background, each holding exactly one circle. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
人少了，
每人分到的就多。
六块分给两个人，
每人三块。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: two boxes side by side on a cream background, each holding three circles. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
可是不是每次都分得完。
七块分给三个人，
每人两块，
还剩一块。
那一块叫余数。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: three boxes in a row on a cream background each holding two circles, plus one circle sitting alone outside the boxes. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
剩下的那块怎么办？
可以切开再分，
可以留到下次，
也可以让给最想吃的人。
说好了就行。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one circle on a cream background divided into three equal wedges by two straight lines. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
分东西不一定分个数。
一根绳子分给两个人，
要从正中间剪；
一杯水分给两个人，
要倒到一样高。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: on a cream background: one horizontal bar with a mark exactly at its midpoint, and below it two equal glasses filled to the same level. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
分时间也一样。
一个玩具两个人玩，
可以一人玩五分钟，
轮流来。
这也是平分。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one circle on a cream background divided into two equal halves, one shaded and one plain. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
最公平的办法之一：
一个人分，
另一个人先挑。
分的人会
尽量分得一样。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: on a cream background: two equal groups of three circles, with one hand shape above the left group and one hand shape pointing at the right group. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
我把六块饼干
一人两块分好了。
大家都没有多，
也都没有少。
分东西原来这么简单。
pages.scene: The little boy and two other children stand around the table, each holding a small plate, all three seen from the waist up and completely inside the picture, smiling at each other.
